finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N52
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: Inherit N<=51. At N=52, the hard region has r<=11. r<=8 is closed by the existing recurrence. r=9 degree-3 roots enter the s<=47,n<=8 tail below cap. r=10 uses a bounded reachable-state bridge; the only numeric clause-count danger d=m=10 is eliminated by the general full-width collapse lemma, yielding m3<=21 and a cap-safe step from s3<=169. The sole r=11 cell (m,L)=(7,33) has all degrees three and enters m<=6 after one ordinary elimination.
